hello.text: Stroud. Harbourmaster. You're not from here, so you're either lost or useful.

t0.text: Frogmen. Out of the sea a month ago. They took Fennick's Landing, west past the river, and since then they've tried us every night. Nine boats left. Forty-one people. I count them every morning.

t1.text: Long enough. I don't say more than that.
